requirements.general: Any one of these: SPM: Pass SPM or equivalent with 3 credits in any subjects UEC: Pass UEC with a Grade B in any 3 subjects O-Level: Pass O-Level with Grade C in any 3 subjects and pass in Maths and English SKM: Pass with level three (3) in a related field and pass SPM with one (1) credit in any subject Certificate: Pass in SKM level 3 or certificate from Kolej Komuniti and pass SPM with 1 credit STPM: Pass STPM with a GPA 2.00/C in any 1 subject Others: Other equivalent qualifications approved by the government of Malaysia English Proficiency Requirements: IELTS: 5.0 TOEFL PBT: 550 MUET: BAND 3.0
